q: Profunctors (distributors) H: C ↛ D are defined as functors H: D^op × C → Set. They represent 'many-valued' maps and are relevant to dynamical systems as they can represent:
exp: A profunctor H: C ↛ D can be seen as a bimodule or a generalised relation. In the context of non-deterministic systems, a Markov transition kernel or a set-valued map (relation) can be expressed as a profunctor. Profunctor composition generalises relational composition.
